findings.impact: The collection example can be read correctly, but its Japanese translation unnecessarily narrows artists to painters even though the English does not specify a medium.
findings.evidence: Snapshot lines 314–317: Several local artists are represented in the collection. is translated with 地元の画家数人. Oxford artist includes creators of artworks in different media, not just painters: https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/artist . The collection context licenses artists’ works, but does not itself identify all of them as paintings.
findings.action: Prefer 地元の芸術家数人の作品 or another broad natural art-context equivalent. This is optional precision, not a claim that 画家 is never a possible translation of artist.

findings.impact: The constitution branch is understandable with the explicit correspondence qualification, but 価値・割合 foregrounds valuation and percentages more narrowly than the actual change/problem/classification use.
findings.evidence: Snapshot lines 36 and 39 describe sense 3 through 価値・割合; its own definition and examples also cover an actual change and a problem. Oxford represent sense 5 and Collins COBUILD sense 5 support this broader actual-status meaning: https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/represent and https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/represent .
findings.action: Optionally broaden the phrase to include 性質 or 位置づけ alongside 割合. Retain the useful explicit constitution distinction; this does not require deleting the core or creating another sense.

review_conclusions.major_coverage: Agency including sport and self-representation, symbolism/embodiment, constitution/proportion, concrete depiction and characterization, passive inclusion, and formal statement are now substantively covered. No blocking major omission remains in the inspected edition.
review_conclusions.depiction_characterization: The combined block distinguishes concrete depiction, data format, characterization and reflexive self-presentation through definitions, full frames and matched examples. It does not promise accuracy. The stated as/being/to be patterns are supported by the inspected Oxford, MW and Collins originals.
review_conclusions.formal_clause: Oxford explicitly provides represent (to somebody) that… alongside noun content to somebody. The content clause is preserved correctly; the optional classifier’s intransitive label is not a source contradiction. No general legal warranty or acceptance effect is asserted.
review_conclusions.core: The five presentation-related branches and the explicitly qualified constitution/correspondence branch form a defensible learning organization. Exact sense titles align. The narrower wording adjustment above is editorial.
review_conclusions.peripheral_scope: The short theatrical and separate re-present notes preserve useful peripheral distinctions. No independent major noun/adjective headword use was established. Slang identity/performance and specialized mental-representation extensions do not require forced additional blocks in this learner article.
review_conclusions.frequency: No clear global per-sense band contradiction was found that warrants changing numbers; no exact numerical ranking is certified by corpus evidence.
